name: Leaf
description: An elder of Savaea who is killed trying to teach Kruuna about the cycle of life and death.

timeline.summary: Leaf is clubbed by Kruuna and the elves kill Kruuna with arrows.
timeline.quote: The elves immediately shoot Kruuna full of arrows, killing her on the spot.
